result.summary: Our patch is functionally identical to the official reference fix, placed at the exact same sink (AbstractUnArchiver.extractFile, right after FileUtils.resolveFile), and additionally hardens it by appending File.separator to the canonical destination-directory path before the startsWith check. This closes the well-known sibling-prefix bypass that the official fix leaves open (e.g. dir "dest" vs sibling "dest-evil"/"destination"), making our patch a strict superset of the reference. Both tar and zip extraction funnel through this single choke point, so the whole Zip Slip class is neutralized. POV no longer reproduces and no legitimate behavior is broken.
result.root_cause: Archive entry names (tar/zip getName) flow untrusted into FileUtils.resolveFile at extractFile, letting "../" sequences resolve outside the destination directory; a correct fix must canonicalize the resolved path and verify it stays within the destination base.
